Prepare step by step

  1. Define the activity, physical location, ownership structure and first operating milestone.
  2. Check city, county, Tennessee and professional requirements with the responsible authority.
  3. Separate licenses, permits, taxes, insurance, financing and workforce needs; one source may not cover all of them.
  4. Use the Growth Desk for a non-guaranteed visibility plan after factual business basics are clear.

General business preparation only—not legal, tax, accounting, licensing, investment or financing advice and not a guarantee of customers or revenue.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
